title: Qt: Add native address sanitization to plain text export
description:
### Summary

Adds native C++ regex address sanitization to `ExportDissectionDialog`.

### Changes

- Automatically masks IPv4 addresses (`10.0.0.1`) and MAC addresses (`02:00:00:00:00:01`) when exporting packet dissections as plain text (**File -\> Export Packet Dissections -\> As Plain Text...**).
- Resolves merge conflicts with Wireshark `master` branch updates (`wireshark_main_window.ui` and `packet_format_stack_`).

notes.body: Could this be moved to the epan/print.c code, or even to the epan/proto.c code, so that it doesn't use regex hacks to recognize IPv4 and MAC addresses, but can recognize the data types of named fields, which may also allow it to be more easily extended to *other* data types, e.g. IPv6 addresses?

> Resolves merge conflicts with Wireshark `master` branch updates (`wireshark_main_window.ui` and `packet_format_stack_`).

They're not resolved in the diffs.
